violations.text: Milk was observed held at 46-47 degrees Fahrenheit post breakfast. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Milk was placed in freezer to rapidly chill, and refrigerator temperature was adjusted colder. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026

The fiberboard side of the hand sink in the preschool area is in poor repair, with pieces missing and crumbling fiberboard exposed. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Food safety manager application given to PIC. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/11/2025

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cheese and margarine) in the refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/01/2025
